# Superintendent Bell

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Superintendent Bell is characterized by his gray whiskers and the spectacles he wears. His appearance is noted as being identical to how he looks during Sunday-school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## History

Superintendent Bell is an acquaintance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who broke his ankle when he was a young boy. During Anne's seven-week recovery after breaking her own ankle in a fall from a roof, he visited her and shared the story of his childhood injury.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P2](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
